basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior AI Engineer | Agentic AI Platforms | Tech Lead | LLM Tooling & Governance
basics.summary: Tech Lead who builds the platforms that other engineers build on. 13+ years shipping production systems for 10M+ users, last 3 spent making LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, and Langfuse work reliably in production. Defined the distributed templating framework now powering 15% of Beekeeper assets, replaced a $337K vendor with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks, and grew the AI engineering cohort that now ships features independently. Hands-on with the agent stack end-to-end, from agent reasoning down to the individual tools and API calls, and equally comfortable influencing platform, product, and vendor teams without direct authority.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns the agentic AI stack end-to-end, from agent architecture and tool integrations to governance, observability, and rollout. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built and shipped production AI agents (LangChain, FastAPI, GCP) for outbound sales. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast $4M approved opportunities per quarter, $1M quarterly revenue at 25% conversion.
Built AI Brain, an intelligent context layer unifying conversation data, usage analytics, and notes via Neo4j, Graphiti, and Zep. Surfaces signals across product, sales, and CS.
Expanded scope to own company-wide AI transformation: governance, access patterns, evaluation, and sales enablement across business units.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Tech Lead defining frameworks, integrations, and AI tooling used across the engineering org. Shipped agentic and LLM systems used by millions while growing the AI engineering team around me.
highlights: Defined the Distributed Templating Engine, a reusable framework for asset creation that now powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users) and cut customer setup time 90%. Reference architecture other teams build on.
Replaced a $337K annual vendor contract with an in-house LLM pipeline (GitHub Actions plus OpenAI APIs) in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated, product team iterates without external gatekeepers.
Built and mentored the AI engineering cohort: hands-on upskilling on LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, and Langfuse. Hired for craft, grew engineers who now lead agentic features independently.
Led the Search Platform revamp across 3 teams. Aligned platform, product, and vendor stakeholders without direct authority, redesigned indexing and ranking, shipped measurable engagement lift.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates architectures and advises on AI adoption and platform decisions.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised portfolio companies on AI strategy, agentic platforms, and engineering frameworks that scale.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built the platform, infrastructure, APIs, and integration layer that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, partnerships with Unilever, CES Las Vegas showcase.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built and scaled Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolving robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolving robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Reference framework adopted by external researchers and students.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied AI.
